unmatched.quote: Score 10: exactly on the threshold. One more clue and it goes to junk; one fewer and it reaches the inbox.
unmatched.problem: The rule is 'score 10 or more goes to junk' (bh.rule), so a score of exactly 10 already goes to junk. 'One more clue and it goes to junk' is wrong. 'One fewer clue' may also mean a loss of 3 points, not 1. hi and te copy the same structure.
unmatched.why: Breaks numbers-and-working: the text contradicts the threshold rule.
unmatched.fix: Use: 'Score 10: exactly on the threshold, so it goes to junk. Take away 1 point and the score is 9, which reaches the inbox.' Apply the same to hi and te.

unmatched.problem: English is 'Meeting moved to 3 pm' (and Telugu says it moved). The Hindi 'हो गई है' means the meeting has already happened, which changes the meaning of the scenario.
unmatched.why: Breaks locale-fidelity: the Hindi does not keep the English meaning.
unmatched.fix: Use: 'मीटिंग 3 बजे के लिए बदल दी गई है।'
